summary: Frontend-only testing completed on the public Preview workspace. All 7 requested desktop bulk-category behaviors passed: select-all and independent checkbox states, indeterminate state, 3-selected action bar, autocomplete wiring, Cancel, six successful PATCH integrations for assign/cleanup, success toast, updated badges, and category filtering. Extended testing found stale hidden selections when the category filter changes and severe mobile horizontal overflow that puts all bulk controls off-screen.

ui_bugs.issue: Changing the category filter does not reconcile selection. Reproduced by selecting both Music Production rows, then filtering to TEST_FILTER_EDGE: the only visible row was unchecked while the bulk bar incorrectly showed '2 selected'; select-all was neither checked nor indeterminate.

issues: The document is 1085px wide in a 390px viewport (695px horizontal overflow). The bulk bar starts at x=291 and is 753px wide; category input, Assign, and Cancel start at x=411, x=577, and x=665, so all controls are outside the initial viewport and require horizontal scrolling.

action_items: Clear selection when categoryFilter changes, or consistently scope selected count, select-all state, and bulk assignment to visible filtered rows.
Make the admin layout responsive and stack/wrap the source row and bulk action controls within the mobile viewport.
critical_code_review_comments: selected is global while select-all state and bulkAssignCategory operate on filteredSources. This mismatch causes stale counts and can produce a success toast for 0 visible matching sources after a filter change.

bulkAssignCategory silently resolves unsupported source shapes with Promise.resolve(), which can report success without making a PATCH; every selectable source should resolve to a valid mutation target or produce an explicit error.
KnowledgeBase.js is 783 lines, above the 700-line review threshold; extract source-list, bulk-actions, editor, and source-row components.

success_rate.frontend: 80% (8/10 checks; all 7 requested desktop behaviors and API integration passed, cross-filter selection and mobile layout failed)

seed_data_creation: Temporarily assigned TEST_BULK_QA to all 3 sources and TEST_FILTER_EDGE to one source. Both were removed by restoring every source to Music Production; final seeded data matched its initial state.
test_credentials: Loaded administrator credentials from /app/memory/test_credentials.md; public Preview login succeeded.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Core desktop bulk assignment is healthy. Re-test filter changes while selections are active: create a one-row temporary category, select rows in another category, then switch filters and verify count/checkbox state. Also remeasure document width and bulk-control bounding boxes at 390x844. Final workspace state has 3 sources, all categorized Music Production.
rca_of_the_issue: KnowledgeBase stores selected keys independently of categoryFilter. The action-bar count renders selected.size, select-all compares selected.size to filteredSources.length, and bulkAssignCategory intersects selected with filteredSources. After switching filters, hidden keys remain selected while visible checkbox state and operations use a different set. Mobile overflow is caused by the fixed 250px sidebar plus desktop-width content/source rows and an uncontained 753px bulk bar.
